source: The club page publishes the authoritative nine-hole totals: Vit 3110 m, Gul 2966 m and Röd 2525 m. Current per-hole values were not published by the club when checked 2026-09-04. Vit rows are transcribed from Caddee because they sum exactly to the official total; Gul and Röd rows are the publicly indexed card whose sums exactly match the club totals. These rows are provisional until the club supplies the current GIT scorecard.
note: Nine physical holes, played twice for an 18-hole par-72 round. Caddee's yellow/red rows conflict with both its own totals and the club totals, and GolfTraxx incorrectly labels the metre card as yards. See docs/courses/ribbingsfors-source-dossier.md. Geometry and card provenance are kept separate.
